scientific_limitations: Finite rectangular bands only; full nonempty-subset power semigroup (not the union-preserving power-set semiring).
The split extension is noncanonical and requires fixed nonrectangle labels.
An older original power-semigroups source was accessible only in a published meeting abstract; unindexed equivalent group computations cannot be categorically excluded.
The proof is general; exhaustive checks of small semigroups are supplementary.
title: Automorphism groups and orbit profiles of rectangular-band power semigroups
